metadata.title: Tactical Professional Seed: High-Demand Gateway Standards
metadata.notes: Essential gateway certifications for immediate job-readiness.

nodes.title: FAA Part 107 (Remote Pilot Certificate)
nodes.description: Rules and regulations for operating small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS). Weather, loading, and performance. Linked to the Manipulator and Terra tracks.

nodes.title: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701 Mapping)
nodes.description: The global standard for foundational cybersecurity skills. Threats, attacks, vulnerabilities, architecture, and design. Mapping mesh immunity to Security+ domains.

nodes.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
nodes.description: Foundational understanding of the AWS Cloud platform. Basic global infrastructure, security, and compliance. Essential on-ramp for all cloud roles.

nodes.title: ASCM Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
nodes.description: End-to-end supply chain management. Design, planning, execution, control, and monitoring. Linking the Mycelial Oracle to professional supply chain standards.

nodes.title: NHA Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT)
nodes.description: Blood collection procedures, safety, and patient interaction. Mapping physiological integrity and mk0-vita standards to professional phlebotomy.

edges.rationale: Robotics platforms provide the mechanical and control intuition for sUAS operation.
Basic mesh security and encryption mastery are the prerequisites for Security+ certification.
Foundational collective decision-making is the basis for professional supply chain design.
